[1/6] Baseline gate repair and EVID-010 trivial-evidence warning

impact_assessment.why: The deep review found five real research-engine gaps; the project gate is also red on pre-existing README and codebase-map drift, so the first milestone repairs the baseline and ships the cheapest evidence-quality warning
impact_assessment.benefits: A green Phase 4 baseline; EVID-010 warns when a quote restates a linked question, duplicates another quote, or carries no content terms, before that quote is treated as support
impact_assessment.risks: contract: adds one warning code and no status change; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: integrity reads only; state: no schema change in this milestone
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first pure and integrity tests, absence tests for legitimate distinct quotes, full suite and 4/4 gates before any commit; later milestones get their own checkpoints

[2/6] Attempt authority: schema v6 test_attempt ledger, earliest non-replaceable attempt selects the NUMERIC evidence group

impact_assessment.why: The current evidence path accepts any current verified group, so a later pass can displace an earlier subject failure and reopen retry-until-pass
impact_assessment.benefits: Every execution is an attempt; the earliest non-replaceable attempt is authoritative; attempt history is visible, exported and checked
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new test_attempt table and schema 6; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: single-writer transactions; state: legacy runs without an attempt row keep the old any-current-group behaviour
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for authority selection, run classification and migration; full suite and 4/4 gates before commit

[3/6] Claim revisions: schema 7 revision_of/superseded_by, claim revise/history, edges repointed to the head, old claim kept as history

impact_assessment.why: Claim text is immutable, so a refined claim either becomes a silently contradicting second claim or leaves a stale statement in the graph
impact_assessment.benefits: A revision chain keeps the old text and verdict history visible while the head carries the live edges; reports and lists hide superseded heads by default
impact_assessment.risks: contract: three additive claim columns and schema 7; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: single-writer transaction; state: edges move to the head, tests stay on the old claim and warn
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for chain creation, provenance refusal, edge repointing, list/history views and migration; full suite and 4/4 gates before commit
